t: This is the Isokon building, a Grade I listed block of 36 reinforced-concrete flats on Lawn Road in Belsize Park. It's an early piece of Modernist housing in London. The Canadian-born Wells Coates designed it, and it's probably the best-known thing he built in England. Jack Pritchard, a furniture entrepreneur who was influential between the two World Wars, commissioned it together with his wife Molly. Some of Pritchard's work is now shown in the Victoria and Albert Museum and the Museum of London.
